name: Massimiliano Allegri
scopeNote: Manager profile of Massimiliano Allegri across three counted spells: AC Milan (25 June 2010 to 13 January 2014: Serie A 2010-11, Supercoppa Italiana 2011), Juventus (16 July 2014 to 26 May 2019: five Serie A, four Coppa Italia and two Supercoppa titles) and Juventus again (1 July 2021 to 17 May 2024: Coppa Italia 2023-24). Dates from the Wikipedia statistics table. Excluded: Aglianese, SPAL, Grosseto and Sassuolo (lower divisions, Sassuolo's Serie C1 title only), Cagliari 2008-10 (no titles), AC Milan 2025-26 (no titles), Napoli 2026 (nine matches).

spellsCounted.reason: Five Serie A titles and four Coppa Italia titles: the side he is known for.

spellsExcluded.reason: Nine matches, too short to count.
